name: planning
type_hint: A planning meeting. Expect explicit decisions with owners and dates, and action items that carry due dates.
text:
Q4 Planning — 2026-08-19, Zoom, 60 minutes

Attendees: Sofia Alvarez (organizer, sofia.alvarez@northwind.example), Tom Beckett (tom.beckett@northwind.example), Priya Raman (priya.raman@northwind.example)

Sofia: We need to decide whether the migration lands in Q4 or slips to Q1. Tom, what's the estimate?

Tom: Six weeks of engineering time if we don't hit surprises with the legacy adapter. Eight if we do.

Sofia: Then we're deciding to target Q4 with a Q1 buffer. I want that written down. Tom owns the migration plan, due September 5th.

Tom: Agreed. I'll have a written plan by the 5th.

Priya: We should also decide on the rollback approach before we start.

Sofia: Good call. Decision: we do a dual-write period rather than a hard cutover. Priya, can you spec that by August 29th?

Priya: Yes.

Sofia: Last thing — we are not hiring a contractor for this. We tried that last year and onboarding ate the savings.
